$comment: CI gate: `check:bundle --budget scripts/bundle-budget.json --enforce`. eagerBytes caps the code evaluated at plugin startup and moduleActivationBytes caps what each module loads when it starts; outputBytes and stylesBytes are ratchets on main.js and styles.css. Lower a limit as code shrinks; never raise one without a recorded reason.
outputBudgetReason: Issue #2：紧凑Git工作区、统一CodeMirror merge比较器、惰性内嵌Diff Worker、笔记历史和检查点恢复闭环；新依赖仅固定MIT的@codemirror/merge，完整许可包含Worker独立依赖。按本次实际产物KiB收紧；没有旧展开式UI双轨。
eagerBudgetReason: Issue #2：启动期增加每窗口EditorContextService、EditorPanel贡献契约和revision-review元数据；React/Radix及Diff Worker仍按需加载。按实际启动闭包KiB取整。
stylesBudgetReason: Issue #2：新增仅限版本比较容器的CodeMirror差异样式及紧凑导航/恢复确认的Tailwind类；保留既有主题令牌。按实际styles.css的KiB取整。
moduleActivationBudgetReason: 保留其他模块原预算。Issue #2：versioning接入纯Git历史查询、恢复日志、原生正文适配器与同步hold；comments增加prepare/commit/abort锚点参与者。两个受影响模块按实际闭包KiB取整，页面和Worker继续惰性加载；预算中的模块缺失现在直接失败。
